label: Clubhouse
summary: Clubhouse is a social audio platform where people host and join live spoken conversations. Maaike uses it as a venue for community building around conversation design. It is the infrastructure behind her Convoclub initiative.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike set up a dedicated conversation design community on Clubhouse called Convoclub, hosting weekly rooms every Friday at 16:00 CET. The sessions are described as casual get-togethers for conversation designers, linguists, bot builders and language lovers, sometimes featuring guests from the conversational space. She also sketchnotes each session. Getting there required enough FOMO to push her into buying an Apple device, which gives a sense of how deliberate the decision was.
open_questions: How did Convoclub develop over time after the initial launch, and did the weekly cadence hold?
What guests appeared and what topics got covered in the conversational space discussions?
